items.title: Enable ProofStory enforce modes in project config
items.context: Add the top-level proofStory config with devGateMode, reviewGateMode, and doneGateMode set to enforce. Related source: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md.

happy.desc: lattice.config.json contains proofStory.devGateMode, proofStory.reviewGateMode, and proofStory.doneGateMode set to enforce.

edge.desc: The config change is scoped to project policy and does not modify ProofStory implementation code.

adversarial.desc: A missing ProofStory artifact would make DEV admission fail when devGateMode is enforce.

verificationEvidence.note: Parsed lattice.config.json and asserted devGateMode, reviewGateMode, and doneGateMode are all enforce after commit f442a9faca280d281b60ed9a4f6284ccd1e3da9a.
Diff for implementer commit only adds the top-level proofStory config block; no ProofStory implementation source files were modified.
ProofStory smoke covers devGateMode=enforce blocking DEV admission when required intent artifacts are missing.

items.title: Record ProofStory intent artifacts for this rollout story
items.context: Before relying on the new global gate, create original intent snapshot, confirmed milestone ledger, intent collision pass, acceptance bindings, and any needed scope/spike evidence for this story itself.

happy.desc: original_intent_snapshot_set, intent_collision_set, proofstory_contract_set, and confirmed milestone ledger artifacts exist for B-e1a8 before DEV enforcement is relied on.

edge.desc: The milestone ledger remains an intent coverage artifact and does not create child stories automatically.

adversarial.desc: proofstory_gate_check mode=enforce fails before the required self-proof artifacts exist and passes after they are complete.

verificationEvidence.note: ProofStory gate check passed with original intent snapshot, confirmed milestone ledger, accepted intent collision, and ProofStory contract all present.
Ledger sizing reported 3/5 within_threshold and did not create child stories; milestone ledger remains intent coverage only.
Smoke verifies enforce-mode gate failure before required ProofStory artifacts and pass after required artifacts are complete.

items.title: Verify DEV REVIEW DONE gate behavior under enforce mode
items.context: Run build, ProofStory smoke, process fact contract verification, and explicit proofstory gate/review/done diagnostics for this story after the config change.

happy.desc: Build, process fact contract verification, and ProofStory hardening smoke pass after the config rollout.

edge.desc: proofstory_review_completeness_check mode=enforce passes for B-e1a8 after verification evidence is recorded.

adversarial.desc: done_intent_equivalence_check mode=enforce passes for B-e1a8 and would fail if a required milestone lacked passing evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && node packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Build passed, process fact contract verified, and ProofStory intent hardening smoke passed after the config rollout.
After recording this complete evidence set, REVIEW completeness is rerun in enforce mode and must pass before TEST.
After recording this complete evidence set, DONE intent equivalence is rerun in enforce mode and must pass before DONE.

auditLog.reason: lattice.config.json now has all three proofStory gate modes set to enforce and config-only verification passed.
Original intent snapshot, confirmed milestone ledger, accepted intent collision, and ProofStory contract are recorded and enforce gate passes.
